description: This file defines the MessageFormatter class in the GuzzleHttp library, responsible for formatting HTTP request and response messages into loggable string formats using variable substitution. It supports various template placeholders to include detailed request, response, and transaction information.

classes.name: MessageFormatter
classes.description: A class for formatting HTTP request and response messages into loggable string representations, supporting customizable templates and variable substitution.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MessageFormatter with an optional template string, defaulting to the CLF format.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Generates a formatted log message string based on the provided request, response, and error, replacing placeholders in the template with actual message data.
